title: Localization extension for intrinsic restriction composition
statement: The Qh representative equality extends by exact localization to a natural-transformation equality between the two pasted restriction paths.

proof.text: Use naturality of both paths and the localization extension principle. Equality on Q-images of cochain complexes is the Qh comparison statement; cancellation along the localization factors gives equality on every derived object.

lean.statement: theorem finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction_comp_natTrans_exists {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m) : ∃ rhs : (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology X) (finiteDualizingQuotient l E (hmn.trans hrm)) ⋙ (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (r + 1))).functor) ⟶ (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).functor ⋙ normalizedDVRRes l E X hmn ⋙ normalizedDVRRes l E X hrm, finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestrictionCompLhs l E X hrm hmn = rhs ∧ ∀ K, rhs.app K = (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (r + 1))).functor.map ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalarsCompIso (ProEt.topology X) (finiteDualizingQuotient_comp l E hrm hmn)).inv.app K) ≫ (finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction l E X hrm).inv.app ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology X) (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hmn)).obj K) ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X hrm).map ((finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction l E X hmn).inv.app K)
